intake_analysis.case_summary: Amber Bell and Erik Devlin entered into a contract with LLW Construction, represented by Mike Winiarek, for home renovations. After multiple payments totaling $100,000, the clients experienced significant issues with the quality of work and incomplete tasks. Despite ongoing communication attempts, the contractor has been unresponsive. The clients have incurred additional costs and are facing potential liens from subcontractors. They seek financial recovery for the payments made and compensation for further expenses related to correcting the work.
desired_outcomes: Reimbursement of payments made for incomplete or substandard work (~$100,000).
Compensation for any additional costs incurred to correct or complete the work.
key_facts: Multiple issues with work quality noted since December 2024.
Legal consultation initiated with Bernhardt Riley.
intake_analysis.financial_impact: Clients have paid $100,000 and face additional costs for repairs and potential liens.
